description: Connect an external agent to a business and its signed event outbox. Requires current business admin membership, an assigned Kai agent, and agents:write, sms:write, webhooks:write. New SMS/WhatsApp conversations route to the external agent; explicit handoffs win. Grants no additional permissions and does not activate unregistered channels. Use a stable idempotency_key; replacements require expected_revision. The signing secret is returned only for a non-replayed connect. External realtime voice and email execution are not connected by this operation.

a2a_enabled.description: Route public A2A message/send to the signed receiver, which must return a JSON-RPC A2A message. SDK handleA2ARequest/handle_a2a_request connects the receiver to your own agent.

a2a_url.description: Optional existing native A2A endpoint; requires a2a_enabled. Omit to use the signed event receiver.

idempotency_key.description: Required in the body or Idempotency-Key header.

name: connect_agent
title: Connect External Agent
